metadata.question: Did the air temperature reach over 50 degrees Celsius at the Furnace Creek Visitor's Center on June 30, 2013?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Furnace Creek Visitor Center, Death Valley, CA (approximately 36.4574°N, 116.8675°W) - Date: June 30, 2013 (single day) - Collection: ERA5-Land hourly data (air temperature at 2m) - provides temperature data globally - Alternative: MODIS Land Surface Temperature if ERA5 unavailable 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for ERA5 reanalysis data (it's modeled, not optical) - Need to convert Kelvin to Celsius - Check maximum temperature across all hours of June 30, 2013 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid result: Temperature value in reasonable range (e.g., -50 to 70°C) - C1: No images found for the date - C2: No valid pixels (unlikely with ERA5, but check) - C3: Result is None, NaN, or unreasonable (e.g., >100°C or <-100°C) - A: Max temperature >= 50°C - B: Max temperature < 50°C ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const furnaceCreek = ee.Geometry.Point([-116.8675, 36.4574]); const targetDate = '2013-06-30'; console.log('Analyzing air temperature at Furnace Creek on June 30, 2013...'); // 2. Data Acquisition & Check // ERA5-Land hourly data for air temperature at 2m const era5 = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY') .filterDate(targetDate, '2013-07-01') .select('temperature_2m'); const imageCount = era5.size().getInfo(); console.log(`ERA5 images found: ${imageCount}`); if (imageCount === 0) { console.log('No ERA5 data available for this date.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Processing - Get maximum temperature across all hours const maxTemp = era5.max(); // 4. Calculation const result = maxTemp.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.max(), geometry: furnaceCreek, scale: 11132, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const tempKelvin = result.temperature_2m; // Check for valid data if (tempKelvin === null || tempKelvin === undefined) { console.log('Temperature calculation returned null.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Convert Kelvin to Celsius const tempCelsius = tempKelvin - 273.15; // 5. Validation & Final Answer console.log(`Maximum temperature: ${tempCelsius.toFixed(2)}°C (${tempKelvin.toFixed(2)}K)`); // Check if temperature is in reasonable range if (tempCelsius < -100 || tempCelsius > 100) { console.log('Temperature value out of reasonable range.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Check if temperature reached over 50°C if (tempCelsius >= 50.0) { console.log('Temperature exceeded 50°C.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Temperature did not reach 50°C.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
